items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I don't believe, that name sounds familiar, but I don't know him.

ctx.x: But I heard he was from St. Louis, Bud Freeman, I know him, played tenor. Mustache. Yeah, I know him, but I heard he was from St. Louis. I don't know where he's from, but I heard that. He's a bad man too, partner.
You know a bass player named Jim Lanagan? Jim Lanagan.
I don't believe, that name sounds familiar, but I don't know him.
